\textbf{Solution:} From the given information, we can determine that the line $y=x+8$ intersects with the line $y=ax+b$ at point P(20, 25).\\
By examining the graphical representation of the functions, it is evident that for $x>20$,\\
the graph of the line $y=x+8$ is located above the graph of the line $y=ax+b$,\\
meaning the solution set for the inequality $x+8>ax+b$ regarding $x$ is: $x>20$,\\
therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{x>20}$.
